name: example-multi-lane
notes: Fill each lane.surfaceId from `wmux list-surfaces` (or agent-state). Only these steps will ever be sent — the supervisor never invents work.

steps.title: JWT types only
steps.prompt: Implement JWT types only under src/auth/types.ts. Do not touch UI or routes. Stop when types compile. Do not start the next task.

steps.title: Token helper
steps.prompt: Add a token encode/decode helper using the types from the previous step. No HTTP wiring yet. Stop when tests for the helper pass (or explain blockers).

steps.title: Login form shell
steps.prompt: Scaffold a login form component only (no real API). Keep scope to the form UI. Stop when the component renders in isolation.
